study_identification_part.si4_title: Resting-State Changes in Aging and Parkinson's Disease Are Shaped by Underlying Neurotransmission: A Normative Modeling Study

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: PD deviation from normal colocalization with GABAA correlated with disease duration; additional tests examined correlations of PD deviation scores with disease duration and cognitive scores (see Tables S23–S29).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Age-related resting-state functional changes colocalize with serotonergic, dopaminergic, noradrenergic, and glutamatergic systems. PD shows deviations from normative aging colocalization, notably involving cholinergic and GABAergic systems; GABAA deviation relates to disease duration.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Across 25,917 UK Biobank HCs, age effects in fALFF/LCOR/GCOR showed spatial colocalization with multiple neurotransmitter systems. Normative models of individual colocalization strengths (age, sex) revealed increased variance with aging. Applying these models to 58 PD cases showed significant deviations for several systems, including cholinergic and GABAergic; PD deviation in GABAA colocalization correlated with disease duration.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Combining normative modeling with neurotransmitter mapping may aid in identifying sensitive markers and potential drug targets for PD and aging-related functional alterations.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: No site/scanner harmonization reported; PD severity scores (e.g., UPDRS, Hoehn & Yahr) unavailable; potential medication effects; UKB healthy volunteer bias; PET maps from differently aged populations may introduce bias.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: All data drawn from UK Biobank. PET maps from healthy volunteers (various systems) via JuSpace; Neuromorphometrics atlas (119 ROIs) used for colocalization. Matched HC subset (n=17,400) used for PD group comparisons.
